topic: Carry any balance on a credit card and you lose the interest-free grace period -- new purchases start charging from day one
title: How You Accidentally Pay Interest on New Purchases
description:
Carrying even a small credit card balance can have a huge hidden cost. It voids your interest-free grace period on all new purchases, meaning you start paying interest from day one.
